about: Cubicle modelled as a generic product: HPL side panels and pilasters on stainless feet, door with rising hinges, indicator bolt and knob, round aluminium head rail with returns to the wall, wall channels, coat hook; a WC pan shows the use (the pan is a separate plumbing fixture in the project). Back wall at y = 0. The 1000 x 1700 type shares the 900 x 1500 geometry. Reference: query: toilet cubicle hpl specialty equipment hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=toilet+cubicle+hpl+specialty+equipment+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
